name: cloaklm
description: Read documents you redacted with CloakLM. Only redacted text leaves the app.
long_description: Connects Claude to the CloakLM desktop app. Documents you share from a CloakLM project (with "Share with AI tools") are readable here, with personal information replaced by placeholders such as [PERSON_1]. Real values and redaction maps never leave CloakLM; paste Claude's answer into CloakLM's Rehydrate panel to see it with the real values. CloakLM must be running.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List the redacted documents shared from CloakLM

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read the redacted text of one shared document
